::: {.book-summary} ## Book Summary Insight 2 Chronicles focuses on Judah's kings and the Temple, emphasizing revival, repentance, and God's faithfulness. The book teaches that sincere repentance brings restoration. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 1
2 Chronicles 1:10
Give me wisdom and knowledge
### Why This Verse Solomon's request ### Chapter Insight This chapter records Solomon's request for wisdom. The key verse highlights the importance of seeking God's wisdom above personal gain. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 2
2 Chronicles 2:6
Who is able to build Him a house?
### Why This Verse God's greatness emphasized ### Chapter Insight This chapter describes preparations for building the Temple. The key verse emphasizes worship as the central purpose of the kingdom. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 3
2 Chronicles 3:1
Mount Moriah
### Why This Verse Temple location identified ### Chapter Insight This chapter records the construction of the Temple. The key verse highlights the fulfillment of God's plan for a permanent place of worship. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 4
2 Chronicles 4:11
Huram finished the work
### Why This Verse Temple furnishings completed ### Chapter Insight This chapter details the Temple furnishings. The key verse emphasizes the beauty and completeness of worship devoted to God. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 5
2 Chronicles 5:13
For He is good; His mercy endures forever
### Why This Verse Glory fills the temple ### Chapter Insight This chapter records the ark being brought into the Temple. The key verse marks the manifestation of God's glory among His people. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 6
2 Chronicles 6:14
There is no God like You
### Why This Verse Solomon's prayer ### Chapter Insight This chapter contains Solomon's prayer of dedication. The key verse emphasizes God's faithfulness to His covenant promises. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 7
2 Chronicles 7:14
If My people who are called by My name
### Why This Verse One of the most quoted verses in the OT ### Chapter Insight This chapter records God's response to Solomon. The key verse reveals God's promise of forgiveness and restoration through repentance. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 8
2 Chronicles 8:16
All the work of Solomon was prepared
### Why This Verse Temple fully established ### Chapter Insight This chapter summarizes Solomon's accomplishments. The key verse highlights faithful completion of God's work. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 9
2 Chronicles 9:8
Blessed be the LORD thy God
### Why This Verse Queen of Sheba's praise ### Chapter Insight This chapter records the visit of the Queen of Sheba and Solomon's greatness. The key verse demonstrates how God's blessing became a testimony to the nations. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 10
2 Chronicles 10:16
What portion have we in David?
### Why This Verse Kingdom divided ### Chapter Insight This chapter recounts the division of the kingdom. The key verse illustrates the consequences of pride and rejecting wise counsel. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 11
2 Chronicles 11:16
Those who set their hearts to seek the LORD
### Why This Verse Faithful remnant ### Chapter Insight This chapter records Rehoboam's early reforms and strengthening of Judah. The key verse emphasizes seeking God as the source of stability. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 12
2 Chronicles 12:6
The LORD is righteous
### Why This Verse Rehoboam's humility ### Chapter Insight This chapter describes Rehoboam's decline and humiliation. The key verse demonstrates the dangers of forsaking God's law. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 13
2 Chronicles 13:12
God Himself is with us
### Why This Verse Abijah's declaration ### Chapter Insight This chapter records Abijah's victory over Israel. The key verse highlights trust in God's covenant faithfulness. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 14
2 Chronicles 14:11
It is nothing with Thee to help
### Why This Verse Asa's prayer of faith ### Chapter Insight This chapter recounts Asa's reforms and victory over Ethiopia. The key verse emphasizes reliance upon God rather than human strength. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 15
2 Chronicles 15:7
Be ye strong therefore
### Why This Verse Encouragement to perseverance ### Chapter Insight This chapter records covenant renewal under Asa. The key verse calls God's people to seek Him wholeheartedly. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 16
2 Chronicles 16:9
The eyes of the LORD run to and fro
### Why This Verse One of Chronicles' most famous verses ### Chapter Insight This chapter describes Asa's later failures. The key verse teaches that God's eyes seek those fully devoted to Him. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 17
2 Chronicles 17:6
His heart was lifted up in the ways of the LORD
### Why This Verse Jehoshaphat's devotion ### Chapter Insight This chapter highlights Jehoshaphat's faithfulness and prosperity. The key verse emphasizes obedience and trust in God. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 18
2 Chronicles 18:13
What my God saith, that will I speak
### Why This Verse Micaiah's faithfulness ### Chapter Insight This chapter records Jehoshaphat's alliance with Ahab. The key verse warns against compromising with ungodly influences. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 19
2 Chronicles 19:7
There is no iniquity with the LORD
### Why This Verse Judicial integrity ### Chapter Insight This chapter recounts judicial reforms in Judah. The key verse emphasizes justice rooted in the fear of God. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 20
2 Chronicles 20:15
The battle is not yours, but God's
### Why This Verse One of the Bible's best-known promises ### Chapter Insight This chapter records Judah's deliverance from overwhelming enemies. The key verse teaches that victory belongs to God. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 21
2 Chronicles 21:20
He departed without being desired
### Why This Verse Judgment on Jehoram ### Chapter Insight This chapter describes Jehoram's wicked reign. The key verse illustrates the consequences of abandoning God's ways. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 22
2 Chronicles 22:7
The destruction of Ahaziah was of God
### Why This Verse Divine sovereignty ### Chapter Insight This chapter records Ahaziah's brief and corrupt reign. The key verse demonstrates the destructive influence of ungodly counsel. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 23
2 Chronicles 23:16
Jehoiada made a covenant
### Why This Verse National renewal ### Chapter Insight This chapter recounts the preservation and coronation of Joash. The key verse highlights God's faithfulness to the Davidic covenant. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 24
2 Chronicles 24:20
Why transgress the commandments of the LORD?
### Why This Verse Zechariah's rebuke ### Chapter Insight This chapter records Joash's reforms and later apostasy. The key verse emphasizes the danger of abandoning God after early faithfulness. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 25
2 Chronicles 25:9
The LORD is able to give thee much more than this
### Why This Verse Trust over financial loss ### Chapter Insight This chapter describes Amaziah's successes and failures. The key verse warns against pride following victory. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 26
2 Chronicles 26:16
When he was strong, his heart was lifted up
### Why This Verse Uzziah's downfall ### Chapter Insight This chapter recounts Uzziah's prosperous reign and downfall. The key verse demonstrates that pride can destroy even successful leaders. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 27
2 Chronicles 27:6
Jotham became mighty because he prepared his ways
### Why This Verse Leadership principle ### Chapter Insight This chapter records Jotham's faithful reign. The key verse highlights steady obedience and personal faithfulness. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 28
2 Chronicles 28:22
In the time of his distress he trespassed yet more
### Why This Verse Ahaz's apostasy ### Chapter Insight This chapter describes Ahaz's wickedness and idolatry. The key verse reveals the consequences of trusting false gods. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 29
2 Chronicles 29:36
God had prepared the people
### Why This Verse Hezekiah's revival ### Chapter Insight This chapter records Hezekiah's cleansing of the Temple. The key verse emphasizes spiritual renewal through returning to God. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 30
2 Chronicles 30:9
The LORD is gracious and merciful
### Why This Verse Call to repentance ### Chapter Insight This chapter describes Hezekiah's Passover celebration. The key verse highlights God's willingness to forgive those who seek Him sincerely. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 31
2 Chronicles 31:21
He prospered because he sought God
### Why This Verse Hezekiah's success ### Chapter Insight This chapter records reforms supporting worship and the priesthood. The key verse demonstrates the blessings of faithful stewardship. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 32
2 Chronicles 32:7
Be strong and courageous
### Why This Verse Hezekiah encourages Judah ### Chapter Insight This chapter recounts God's deliverance from Assyria. The key verse emphasizes trust in God's power rather than fear of enemies. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 33
2 Chronicles 33:13
He prayed unto Him, and He was entreated
### Why This Verse Manasseh's repentance ### Chapter Insight This chapter records Manasseh's wickedness and later repentance. The key verse demonstrates the depth of God's mercy toward the repentant. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 34
2 Chronicles 34:31
The king stood and made a covenant
### Why This Verse Josiah's reform ### Chapter Insight This chapter describes Josiah's reforms and the rediscovery of the Law. The key verse highlights the transforming power of God's word. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 35
2 Chronicles 35:21
God commanded me to make haste
### Why This Verse Josiah and Necho ### Chapter Insight This chapter records Josiah's Passover and death. The key verse emphasizes devotion to worship and covenant faithfulness. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 36
2 Chronicles 36:23
Who is among you of all His people? Let him go up
### Why This Verse Closing call to r ### Chapter Insight This chapter recounts Judah's fall and the beginning of restoration. The key verse demonstrates God's faithfulness even in judgment by preserving hope for return. :::
